    for c in cs:
        ds=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(c[:,:2],axis=0),axis=1)
        t=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.maximum(ds,1.))]
        curve=CubicSpline(t,c,bc_type='natural')
        start=world(c[0]);direction=world(curve(.05))-start;direction[2]=0;direction/=np.linalg.norm(direction)
        approach=start.copy();approach[2]=.04
        line(approach-direction*.004,.08,3)
        approach[2]=.023
        line(approach-direction*.004,.02,2)
        line(approach,.008,3)
        a=len(points)
        line(start,.008,3)
        n=max(2,int(np.ceil(t[-1]/.4)))
        for v in curve(np.linspace(0,t[-1],n+1)[1:]):
            v[2]=np.clip(v[2],.05,15);points.append(world(v))
        points.extend([points[-1].copy() for _ in range(3)])
        end=points[-1].copy();end[2]=.026
        line(end,.008,3)
        ranges.append((a,len(points)))
        end[2]=.045;line(end,.025,2)
    line([-.02,0,.08],.07,10)
    return np.array(points),ranges

def main():
    src=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else OUT+'/fit.npz'
    data=np.load(src);cs=[data[str(i)] for i in range(15)]
    points,ranges=make_path(cs)
    s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json',render=False);s.reset();s.record_start()
    # PD velocity feed-forward compensates the position drive's 0.1 s lag.
    velocities=np.gradient(points,axis=0)/.05
    commands=points+.085*velocities
    measured=[];t0=time.time()
    for i,pos in enumerate(commands):
        q,ok,err=s.ik(pos)
        if not ok:raise RuntimeError(('IK failure',i,pos,err))
        s.step(q);measured.append(s.tip_pose()[0])
        if i%500==0:print('step',i,'/',len(points),'seconds',round(time.time()-t0,1),flush=True)
    actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,OUT+'/trajectory.npz')
    Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(OUT+'/canvas.png')
    np.savez(OUT+'/realized.npz',desired=points,measured=np.array(measured),ranges=ranges)
    strokes=s.strokes()
    np.savez(OUT+'/strokes.npz',**{str(i):st['samples'] for i,st in enumerate(strokes) if st['sheet']=='main'})
    print('state',s.state_sha(),'n_steps',s.n_steps,flush=True)
    metrics=s.score();print(json.dumps(metrics,indent=2),flush=True)
    json.dump(metrics,open(OUT+'/metrics.json','w'),indent=2)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
